## Google AI Overview monitor
Every morning this checks your keywords on Google (through the CrawlerData API), tells you whether Google shows an **AI Overview**, whether it **cites your domain**, and posts the result to Slack.

1 CrawlerData credit per keyword per run.

## Setup
1. Create a CrawlerData API key at https://app.crawlerdata.com (50 free credits on sign-up).
2. Add an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: header `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`, and select it in the CrawlerData request node.
3. Create a Slack incoming webhook and paste its URL in the Slack node.
4. Edit the keyword list and your domain in the first Code node, click **Test workflow**, then activate.
